thread:
incidents-bot: 🔔 Alert: KV cache eviction rate spike on cluster-us-west1; p99 latency > 3s; SLO breach detected for streaming endpoints. Incident ID: INC-2460005555

marta: acked. I'm oncall. popping in. anyone already looking?

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2460005555 assigned to marta. Pager duty page sent.

ben: seeing a lot of streaming stalls reported from prod-model-a and prod-model-b. p95 up from ~180ms to ~900ms, p99 ~3.2s.

marta: thanks. impacts: customer A (chat app) got multiple stalled sessions; CS reported escalations. Dina, can you pull top trace?

dina: pulling traces now. initial grep shows KV prefill miss rate jumped ~4x. decode-side lookups spiking. pattern looks like prefill vs decode imbalance — prefill writes beating decode reads -> frequent evictions.

charlie: also seeing system OOM/kpage metrics on some worker VMs. Paging spikes correlate with eviction events. likely fragmentation of KV slab.

ben: interesting — pod logs show many small prefill batches creating lots of short-lived keys. eviction churn is high.

marta: ok triage: (1) mitigate customer impact (routing/limit), (2) reduce eviction pressure, (3) longer-term follow-up. immediate mitigation ideas?

dina: we can temporarily reduce prefill_batch_size for models with long context to reduce churn. env var: PREFILL_MAX_BATCH=32 -> 8.

charlie: also can flip the KV eviction policy to aggressive compaction (eviction_mode=compact) to reduce fragmentation. downside: might increase decode misses briefly.

ben: traffic routing: we can shift a subset of requests to us-east1 which has spare capacity and lower eviction pressure. need to update routing policy in kong config or runtime routing service.

marta: do that. ben, can you start a controlled redirect of 20% of streaming sessions to us-east1? add canary header so we can measure.

ben: on it. running:
```
# route 20% of streaming traffic for model-a to us-east1
curl -X POST https://routing.internal/api/v1/route -d '{"model":"prod-model-a","percent":20,"target":"us-east1"}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTE_TOKEN"
```

ben: route applied. metrics incoming. p95 for routed requests ~120ms. good signal.

marta: infra, please pause any autoscaler downscale actions to keep extra nodes alive while we stabilize.

infra-bot: Autoscaler pause requested by marta. Pause applied to cluster-us-west1 for 30m.

charlie: I'll flip eviction_mode for the hot shard on cluster-us-west1. running patch now.

charlie: patch applied. eviction_mode=compact for shards 3-5. watching.

dina: also lowering PREFILL_MAX_BATCH for long-context models (prod-model-a/b) via config map. applying:
```
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/model-a PREFILL_MAX_BATCH=8
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/model-b PREFILL_MAX_BATCH=8
```

marta: good. any quick wins on paging? can we temp increase vm memory for affected nodes to reduce swapping?

charlie: we can increase node pool instance type or spin up extra instances with larger ephemeral memory. that takes ~5-7 minutes. starting now.

ben: customer impact update: Customer A (chat app) had ~1200 sessions affected, error rate for streaming up 6% last 10m. CS is informed.

marta: mark customer-impact seen. assign outreach: later follow-up from success. For now focus on stabilization.

ben: after the initial mitigations, p95 dropped from 900ms -> 260ms over 8 minutes. p99 is down to ~1.1s. stalls frequency reduced by ~70%.

dina: KV metrics: eviction rate down 65%, prefill miss rate stabilizing. decode hit-rate slowly recovering. fragmentation compaction seems to be working.

marta: great. escalate to oncall handoff plan: I'm going off-shift in ~35m. who will take primary?

charlie: I'm available for handoff.

marta: ok charlie you will be primary. ben you stay as secondary and continue routing watch. Dina keep looking at traces.

charlie: taking it. I'll keep the autoscaler paused until we confirm stable p99 < 800ms for 20m.

marta: do another quick mitigation: reduce continuous prefill cache window for long sequences to 45s (was 120s) to let compaction free older keys faster. add config: PREFILL_CACHE_TTL=45s.

dina: applied to config map for long-context models.

ben: routing rollback plan: if us-east1 p99 degrades or errors increase, I'll revert routing immediately.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: handoff in 30 minutes. Please document actions.

marta: documenting steps in incident doc. quick note for postmortem: root cause hypothesis = KV slab fragmentation from uneven prefill vs decode access pattern (prefill heavy writes for long-context sessions) leading to high eviction churn; combined with node memory pressure causing paging and tail latency spikes.

charlie: noted. immediate follow-ups: longer-term fixes: (1) improve KV allocator to compact live slabs, (2) rate-limit prefill writes per-session, (3) smarter prefill batching heuristics to match decode throughput, (4) add backpressure signal from decode stage to prefill.

dina: can we also add observability: track prefill:decode ratio per model, eviction-churn per-shard, slab-frag-index. add to console alerts.

marta: agreed. add to postmortem action items.

ben: current metric snapshot: p95=240ms, p99=900ms, eviction rate down 70% from peak, streaming error rate ~1.2% now.

marta: ok good enough to start removing temporary routing after we confirm stability. set a 30m stabilization window.

charlie: will keep autoscaler paused. if anything regresses ping me @charlie.

dina: I pushed a small hotfix to reduce tiny-key churn by coalescing small prefill writes into batch writes for 60s window — applied as runtime feature flag (kv.coalesce_small_writes=true).

ben: flag looks good. heap/paging metrics dropping further.

marta: thanks team. I'm going to wrap up handoff notes and add follow-ups to the incident ticket. charlie you're primary.

charlie: acknowledged. I'll take it from here and keep the runbook updated.

marta: handoff complete. I'm off-shift. thanks. :wave:

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2460005555 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring.

charlie: post-incident notes: set immediate P1 follow-ups:
- engineering: KV allocator compaction task (owner: infra)
- runtime: implement prefill backpressure (owner: eng-runtime)
- observability: new metrics and alerts (owner: eng-sre)
- product/success: customer notifications & RCA (owner: CS)

charlie: closing thread for live coordination. will follow up with full postmortem.

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2460005555 transitioned to status: resolved (monitoring).
